scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/demo build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/core typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/demo typecheck
scripts.lint: oxlint packages/core/src packages/demo/src packages/core/vite.config.ts packages/demo/vite.config.ts packages/demo/uno.config.ts
scripts.format: oxfmt --write package.json packages/core/package.json packages/demo/package.json packages/core/src packages/demo/src packages/core/vite.config.ts packages/demo/vite.config.ts packages/demo/uno.config.ts packages/core/tsconfig.json packages/demo/tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json packages/core/package.json packages/demo/package.json packages/core/src packages/demo/src packages/core/vite.config.ts packages/demo/vite.config.ts packages/demo/uno.config.ts packages/core/tsconfig.json packages/demo/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check
